#image("/imgs/ap-calc-bc-2014-frq-03-diagram-01.png", width: 65%)

The function $f$ is defined on the closed interval $\[- 5 \,4 \]$. The graph of $f$ consists of three line segments and is shown in the figure above. Let $g$ be the function defined by $g(x)= integral_(- 3)^(x) f(t) d t$.

(a) Find $g(3)$.

(b) On what open intervals contained in $- 5 < x < 4$ is the graph of $g$ both increasing and concave down? Give a reason for your answer.

(c) The function $h$ is defined by $h(x)= frac(g(x),5 x)$. Find $h'(3)$.

(d) The function $p$ is defined by $p(x)= f lr((x^(2)- x))$. Find the slope of the line tangent to the graph of $p$ at the point where $x = - 1$.
